_about: Speaking voices (Kokoro TTS recipes). Jonny picked these by ear on 2026-10-25 from audio/voice-test-01; the other test voices were rejected as scary or bad, don't bring them back without asking him. A character uses one with "tts": "<name>"; a say or narrate line can pick another with "voice". voice = Kokoro voices to blend (weights), pitch in semitones.

reaper.note: test 01 Reaper A: flat, low British monotone

wizard.note: test 01 Wizard B: warm British gentleman

odin.note: test 01 Wizard C: jolly, grandfatherly; Jonny's pick for Odin (Norse god)

robot.note: test 01 Phoenix B: Jonny's pick for a robot

pebble.note: Pebble the tortoise (5 Nov 2026): calm, older, slow and warm; awaiting Jonny's ear (options pebble-b, pebble-c)

pebble-b.note: Pebble option B: a rounder, warmer grandfather

pebble-c.note: Pebble option C: a softer storyteller

pebble-k1.note: voice lab 6 Nov 2026: Pebble A without the pitch shift (the phase-vocoder shift is the likeliest metallic sound), a storyteller's phrase pauses and a warmer, softer top

pebble-k2.note: voice lab: one unblended voice (bm_fable, a softer storyteller), no pitch shift, phrase pauses, warm EQ

pebble-k3.note: voice lab 2 (6 Nov 2026): Jonny liked A cleaned + Fable cleaned; a Kokoro mix of both, slower, longer pauses

age-slow.note: a generated line slowed to Pebble's pace (formants kept), nothing else

age-none.note: a recorded line cleaned and levelled, nothing else

pebble-own-a.note: Jonny's own take, older (6 Nov 2026 option A): 2 semitones down, a little slower, warmer, a faint tremor

pebble-own-b.note: option B: an old storyteller, 3 down, slower, a clear tremor

pebble-own-c.note: option C: a bigger, deeper chest (formants lowered with the pitch)

pebble-scot-3.note: voice lab 6 Nov 2026 (Jonny liked Scottish + option 3): Scottish read (espeak Scottish phonemes) -> Chatterbox voice conversion into Pebble's older synthetic voice -> calm narrator melody -> warm EQ

pebble-scot-4.note: as pebble-scot-3, a little older (option 4): 6 % slower, faint 5 Hz tremor, softer top

pebble-ital-3.note: Italian accent rules (accents.json) on the warm British read, then the same chain as pebble-scot-3

pebble-d.note: Pebble option D: an American grandfather, slow and warm
